prompt: Prepare the PM morning note: overnight P&L, largest active exposures, limit pressure, and trade actions by urgency.

args.name: Portfolio Command Center Note
args.data: The served rows contain no overnight return or P&L field, so overnight P&L cannot be reported. The two Open active exposures are 0.0389 and 0.0742, making 0.0742 the largest displayed exposure. Limit-utilization scores are 85.25 and 1.89, so 85.25 is the higher displayed pressure reading, although no limit threshold is supplied. Trade-idea scores are 62.35 and 74.79; by score, the 74.79 row ranks first in urgency and the 62.35 row ranks second. Because neither row names a trade action, map those ranked readings to actual trades and available limit headroom before execution.
